name: uk.co.dwlf/mcp-server
title: DWLF
description: Market conditions, events, custom events and backtests as tools. Bitcoin on-chain via DWLF Block.

environmentVariables.name: DWLF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your DWLF API key. An agent can get one from POST https://api.dwlf.co.uk/v2/agent/register.

environmentVariables.name: DWLF_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool set: full (default, every tool) or block (the Bitcoin subset for DWLF Block).

environmentVariables.name: DWLF_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Leave unset for production.
